verdict.rationale: The Ohio Secretary of State is a government business-filing agency and portal, not an AI agent or host application. Acting as an MCP client that consumes tools from plugged-in MCP servers is therefore a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows any AI-host or agent capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
